title: Give every knowledge worker their own xSquad
excerpt: Give every knowledge worker their own xSquad: a personal squad of AI teammates for research, drafts, follow-ups and reports.
content_html:
xSquads for every knowledge worker

Make every marketer, analyst, chief of staff, support rep, ops lead, finance lead 10x

The productivity multiplexer for knowledge workers: a personal squad of AI teammates that takes on the busywork, on your own files and folders, while you direct the work and review the results.

Use cases

Pick your work area to see what a squad does there.

Campaigns, content, lead research and launch plans, drafted and shipped.

Your squad

  • NO

    Nova

    Growth Lead

    Plans campaigns and keeps the launch calendar moving.

  • QU

    Quill

    Content Writer

    Drafts posts, emails and landing page copy in your voice.

  • SC

    Scout

    Lead Researcher

    Finds and qualifies prospects that fit your customer profile.

Missions you can hand off

  • Plan next month's launch and break it into tasks
  • Draft a three-email nurture sequence for new signups
  • Build a researched list of prospects in one segment
  • Rewrite the pricing page for a new audience
  • Turn a product update into posts for every channel

What you get back

  • A launch plan and drafts waiting in Review, not a blank page.
  • Prospect lists with the reasoning behind each pick.
  • Content that sounds like your team, ready to edit and ship.

Why now

Everyone has a backlog that never shrinks

Research you meant to do, drafts you never started, follow-ups that slipped. The work that matters gets squeezed out by the work that is just there.

Hand it off to a squad

Give your squad a mission and point it at your folder. Bots pick up the research, drafts, follow-ups and reports while you focus.

You stay in charge

Everything lands in Review first. You approve, edit or send it back, so the output is yours and the busywork is not.

How it works

1

Build your squad

Pick bots and give each a role, like Growth Lead, Analyst or Support Agent. Your squad is yours alone.

2

Give them a mission

Point the mission at a local folder and set the goals. Chat with the squad the way you would with a team.

3

Watch the work move

Bots pick up cards on the task board and move them across. Finished work waits in Review until you say Done.

What makes it work

Every knowledge worker gets their own squad

Not one shared bot for the whole company. Each person directs a squad shaped to their job.

Works on your own files and folders

Local-first. Missions point at a folder on your machine, so bots work where your work already lives.

Humans and bots on one task board

Backlog to Done, with Review in between. Nothing is finished until a person signs it off.

Roles, channels and routines

Give bots clear roles, talk in channels and set routines for the work that repeats.

Many AI engines under one squad

Squads can be powered by several AI engines, so you are not tied to a single one.

Set up and tuned by us

We handle the setup and keep tuning as your team learns what works.

See services

Services

You do not have to figure out squads alone. We do the setup and the building.

  • Discovery: map the work each role does today
  • A squad set up for every knowledge worker
  • Tools and folders connected, roles and routines defined
  • Training for your team and guardrails you control
  • Bespoke squads for your specific use cases
  • Custom roles and routines that fit your process
  • Integrations with the tools you already use
  • Internal tools built alongside the squad

  1. Step 1

    Discover

    We learn how each team works.

  2. Step 2

    Set up

    Squads, folders, roles and tools.

  3. Step 3

    Roll out

    Train people and go live together.

  4. Step 4

    Tune

    Refine roles and routines with use.

What is a personal AI assistant for work?

A personal AI assistant for work takes on research, drafts, follow-ups and reports for one person, on the files they already use. In xSquads that is a personal squad of AI teammates. Finished work waits in Review until you approve it.

What is an xSquad?

An xSquad is your own squad of AI teammates. Each bot has a role, like Growth Lead or Research Analyst, and picks up cards on a shared task board while you direct the work and review the results.

Is xSquads only for developers?

No. xSquads is built for all office work: marketing, research, support, operations, finance, HR, legal, product and more. Software is just one of the things a squad can do.

Where does my data live?

Missions point at a local folder, so bots work on your own files and folders on your machine. You choose what each squad can see.

Do the bots replace people?

No. Bots take on the busywork and hand finished work to Review. A human checks it before anything moves to Done.

How do we get started?

Use our setup and rollout service. We run discovery, set up a squad for every knowledge worker, connect tools and folders, define roles and routines, train your team and set guardrails.

Can you build a squad for our process?

Yes. With Custom xSquads we design bespoke squads for your specific use cases, including custom roles, routines, integrations and internal tools.

Get the xSquads newsletter

New squads, tutorials and what we're learning about AI teammates at work. A couple of emails a month.

Make everyone on your team a 10x knowledge worker. Tell us where to start.
